svg.title: Thus the integrals are Cauchy. The finite polynomial insertion numerator is built from the scalar-normalized density, transported primary insertions and local error insertions by exactly these operations. Its Confluence follows from the corresponding fixed-level field and density statements. The scalar-normalized partition integrals are likewise Cauchy. Their common positive lower bound is kept before division. At fixed level j and volume p, let E be the number of sites, v the positive small-field threshold, H = 2 bβj, and let K be the uniform upper bound for the action and activity costs on the selected small-field neighborhood. Write Dmat for the fixed finite real matrix-coordinate dimension entering this estimate, denoted dimR Mat(G)
